title: Expense approval guide
body:
Expenses under $200 need a team lead approval.
Expenses of $200 or more need a finance approval.
Keep the receipt with the request.

title: Document review guide
body:
A draft document must show its source before approval.
If the source is missing, send the draft for manual review.

title: Board planning note
body: The board-only strategy is reviewed at the next board meeting.
